propositions: The typecheck Makefile target runs mypy only on src/rebar, excluding 47 Python files in scripts/ that are linted but type-unchecked despite being invoked by CI gating steps.

Widening the typecheck scope to include scripts/ surfaces 15 mypy errors across 6 files (missing container annotations, lost None narrowings, and latent bugs like calling .strip() on str | None and passing possibly-None dicts).

Two latent bugs were detected and fixed: capture_jira_fixtures._truthy calling .strip() on str | None, and check_complexity_baseline._run_lock passing a possibly-None dict due to a narrowing guard in only one branch of if/else.
The sys.path bootstrap code in 9 scripts/ files requires no mypy configuration changes because pyproject.toml already sets follow_imports='silent' and ignore_missing_imports=true.
All 15 mypy errors were fixed at source without per-module overrides or new # type: ignore comments; two existing unused ignores were removed from check_raw_git_writes.py.
